purpose.summary: A test and validation program for a custom file handler (mar-handler) in an ACUCOBOL-based merchandise management system. It exercises sequential, relative, and indexed file I/O operations including locking, unlocking, read-next/previous, delete, rewrite, and start operations across multiple ISAM files (MXMARQUE, MXART, MXLDIS, MXCATFOU). The program appears to be a developer test harness for verifying correct behavior of a custom file I/O handler.
